short_description: Scale three coffee recipes by dose, then follow timed pours and cumulative water targets.
description: Scale three coffee recipes by dose, then follow timed pours and cumulative water targets. Choose V60, French press or AeroPress with the wheel. Click to set 8–40 g coffee, then click again to brew. The back shows cumulative water weight at each step. Start pauses or resumes the clock. When a step expires, the bar waits for your click before advancing. Click through the final step to finish.
changelog: New screen transitions and high-contrast LED previews.
